# DEFINITION_OF_DONE

This file is a companion artifact to SEC, not part of SEC core.
Use it to define what counts as complete after execution context and phase boundaries are already clear.

## Metadata
- Status: <active|draft|example>
- Last Updated: <YYYY-MM-DD>
- Owner: <owner>
- Reviewed By: <reviewer or review state>
- Source Of Truth: commit the real companion version of this file when collaborators rely on it

## General

A task is complete only when:

- the intended behavior exists
- the change is scoped to the approved work
- the code or artifact is committed
- the basic happy path is verified
- there are no known unresolved blockers hidden behind the word "done"

## Collaboration Checks
- shared context is updated if the work changed what others should do
- proof artifacts exist when the milestone needs them
